fields.name: date
fields.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today if omitted.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Time in 24-hour HH:MM:SS format. Defaults to 12:00:00 (noon). Moon moves ~13 degrees per day so time affects phase precision.

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: IANA name (e.g. "America/New_York", "Europe/London"), decimal hours (e.g. -5 for EST, 1 for CET), or a fixed UTC offset (e.g. "-05:00"). IANA resolved to the DST-correct offset for the given date. With `date` omitted, today is the date in this zone. Defaults to 0 (UTC).
